info.title: ApiToolKit - YouTube API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for YouTube Data API v3 and YouTube Analytics API. Covers Auth (OAuth2), Channels, Videos, Playlists, Playlist Items, Comments, Search, Subscriptions, Live Broadcasts, Live Streams, Analytics Reports, and Captions.

get.summary: Handle OAuth2 callback and exchange authorization code for tokens

post.summary: Refresh an access token using a refresh token

get.summary: Get a channel by ID or handle
List comment threads for a video or channel

post.summary: Insert a top-level comment on a video

put.summary: Update the text of a comment

post.summary: Set the moderation status of a comment
Transition a broadcast to a new status (testing, live, complete)
Bind a broadcast to a live stream
Add a video to a playlist

delete.summary: Remove an item from a playlist

get.summary: Search YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists
List subscriptions for the authenticated user or a channel
Get details of a specific video

post.summary: Upload a single video with metadata
Upload multiple videos in a single request
